error[ZBX-E0315]: a --sysctl is not valid
  cause  'net.core.somaxconn' has no value: write key=value
  fix    a valid sysctl looks like this:   zbx run --rootfs ./alpine --sysctl net.core.somaxconn=8192 -- /bin/sh
  more   zbx explain E0315 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0315.html
